description: Three windowed comparators sharing one input, each putting out a gate while the input lies between its own two thresholds

params.text: Sets the upper threshold for that comparator, -10V to +10V; the input must be under it for that gate to open
Sets the lower threshold for that comparator, -10V to +10V; the input must reach it for that gate to open
Cycles that comparator through three modes: windowing with no light, lower threshold only with a red light, and upper threshold only with a blue light

inputs.text: The voltage all three comparators test, polyphonic; the channels patched here set how many channels each gate output carries

outputs.text: Goes to 10V while the input is inside that comparator's thresholds and 0V the rest of the time, one channel per input channel

notes: setting a comparator's upper threshold below its lower one splits the range in two, the lower threshold then passing everything above it and the upper threshold everything below it
menu: Close interval toward zero — puts the equality test on the side nearer zero when a threshold is negative, changing which end of the window takes in its own voltage
